patch.value: Normalize local parent shorthand consistently with dependency identifiers

Manual packed-CLI testing showed that create --parent parent-a persists the literal dangling reference while --dep id=parent-a normalizes to pm-parent-a. Define an SDK-first identifier contract for parent scalars: either normalize unqualified local identifiers consistently or emit an explicit ambiguity/refusal with an executable canonical retry, without breaking intentional cross-workspace references.
